lines.1: 「Look at it the other way: as long as I never hire a permanent member, she'll stay here as our substitute forever.」
lines.2: Oh boy. There she went again.
lines.4: 「Don't worry. I've decided I won't let her escape, so she'll remain on the student council.」
lines.5: 「I'm the type who keeps what I want close at hand.」
lines.6: ...That confidence, that certainty, and the drive to make anything she declared come true.
lines.8: 「Anyway, that means we've got all the people we need.」
lines.9: 「We really did find them quickly, one way or another.」
lines.10: 「In that case, shall we order pizza and have ourselves a party?」
lines.11: 「...Princess. I understand how you feel, but that is forbidden.」
lines.12: 「Oh, I thought so. I tried slipping it in casually, but nothing gets past you, Otome-senpai.」
lines.13: 「Then let's go to the cafeteria. The lunch rush is over, so it should be empty.」
lines.17: 「Nagomin! Ahaha! Sounds like some kinda monster!」
lines.19: 「Now, now. Otome-senpai here is a third-year, and she says she's treating us.」
lines.20: 「At a time like this, it is only proper for me, as the eldest, to pay.」
lines.21: As expected, she knew exactly how to use an athlete's code against them.
lines.22: 「Lucky you. This executive committee is your own private harem.」
lines.24: 「I'll skip out whenever I feel like it. And Fukahire just panics and digs his own grave... Poor bastard.」
lines.25: 「You're the main man here, Vice President.」
lines.26: 「You could find a girlfriend in this bunch, couldn't you?」
lines.28: 「I'm rooting for you. Don't worry--whether it's the Princess, Otome, Yoppi, Miss Inori, or Yashi, I'll step aside for you.」
lines.30: 「Nah, I just can't wait to see you give in to the moment and charge headlong into love.」
lines.31: 「Anyway, sorry, but I'm off to practice.」
lines.33: 「Perhaps he's what you'd call a lone wolf. Well, the look suits him, so I don't mind.」
lines.35: 「Maybe he's just shy 'cause there's so many people he doesn't know?」
